scene: The tram drops you at Sky Station transit plaza.
picture: Pixel art flat side view of a bustling transit station floor. On the far left stands a transparent glass elevator shaft. To its right, the South Asian girl in her teal hoodie sits in her purple wheelchair. In the centre waits a red steam train. On the far right is a yellow delivery truck.
shown: A tall glass elevator shaft with glowing water pipes on the far left.
A striped red steam train waiting puffed at a platform in the centre.
A yellow flatbed delivery truck parked with its ramp down on the far right.

variants.scene: A crimson locomotive chugs puffs of smoke into the dusky sky.
Airships drift above while you search the busy rooftop depot for {quest}.
The platform bustles with commuters under strings of glowing lanterns.
